remarks: Step inside this beautifully renovated mobile home that feels just like a modern single-family house! Featuring real hardwood floors, a covered front porch, and new Hardie board siding for durability and style. The custom kitchen shines with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, dishwasher, and recessed lighting throughout. Enjoy comfort year-round with natural gas heating and cooling, central air, and energy-efficient foam insulation. The fully tiled bathroom includes a glass shower and in-unit laundry. There's even an extra bonus room perfect for a home office, gym, or guest space. Located in Norwalk, close to restaurants, stores, and major routes, this home blends modern living, low maintenance, and convenience in one smart package! Financing available.
